title: Remove Persona reconciliation mutations from ReadSurfacePorts
summary_zh: 將 Persona provisioning reconciliation 的所有寫入從 ReadSurfacePorts 移至明確的 Persona write-owner command port；保留 terminal ledger、補償、cron cleanup 與 BFF overlay 行為。

owned: authoritative Persona write-owner delegation for terminal and in-flight reconciliation projections
regression coverage for the deployed ReadSurfacePorts update_persona warning
not_changing: Persona service lifecycle transition policy and governance authority
the extracted personas/service.py router boundary and its existing readback suite until the canonical artifact contract is formally expanded
composes_with: post-merge Pantheon dev FE/BFF hosted acceptance

contracts.read_write_boundary: The owned reconciliation paths in main.py use one PersonaProvisioningReconciliationMutationPort backed by persona_write_owner. ReadSurfacePorts remains read-only and this task does not add a compatibility mutation delegation to it.
contracts.terminal_durability: paper_running and provisioning_failed reconciliation projections carry their state and metadata to the write owner, while the durable provisioning ledger remains the terminal decision source.
contracts.preserved_behaviour: The change leaves lifecycle policy, compensation, required cron cleanup, authoritative runtime readback, and BFF overlay updates in their existing owners and execution order.
contracts.failure_signature: The deployed warning being repaired is: ReadSurfacePorts object has no attribute update_persona. The new regression invokes reconciliation against a real read-only ReadSurfacePorts instance and asserts the signature is absent.

verification.details: The declared read-surface regression suite passed 3/3. After removing the undeclared test_persona_provisioning_readback.py drift, the legacy readback suite passed its first 2 cases then failed at test_exact_authoritative_identity_fresh_single_worker_and_first_eval_succeeds because its fixture does not inject the explicit PersonaProvisioningReconciliationMutationPort; the production port correctly fails closed with PersonaWriteOwnerUnavailable when no Persona service URL is configured. This is a task-related fixture mismatch, not an unrelated baseline failure. The task must not enter review until Human/Ops either adds that test to the canonical artifacts or directs a different in-scope compatibility strategy.

scope_reconciliation.required_decision: Approve adding test_persona_provisioning_readback.py to the artifact contract so its isolated mutation-port fixture can be updated, or provide an alternative approved compatibility boundary.
